label: Kahn's algorithm
subgoals: Remove a ready vertex and decrement its successors' in-degrees
Report a cycle if vertices remain with none ready

label: Depth-first search order
subgoals: Run depth-first search and record finishing times
Reverse the finishing order to obtain a topological order
Detect a cycle from an arc to a vertex on the stack

label: How free the order is
subgoals: Count a vertex's ancestors to find its earliest position
Count its descendants to find its latest position
Check that results depend only on the order being topological
